title: Additional GUTI
text: a) if the UE performs the registration procedure due to inter-system change from S1 mode to N1 mode, the UE operates in single-registration mode and the UE has a valid 5G-GUTI; or
b) the UE holds two valid native 5G-GUTIs and one of the valid native 5G-GUTI was assigned by the PLMN with which the UE is performing the registration
